title: The Shah of Persia agrees to a constitution
summary: Mozaffar ad-Din Shah Qajar signed a decree agreeing to create an elected parliament, the Majlis, a victory for the Persian Constitutional Revolution.
reason: Merchants, clergy and reformers protested against royal corruption, foreign concessions and arbitrary rule, staging mass sit-ins in Tehran.
significance: It made Persia one of the first countries in Asia with a constitution and parliament.
